Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE isolated top-down three-quarter pixel-art office prop for Midlife Survivors. The attached desk is a STYLE REFERENCE only, match its crisp chunky shapes, warm upper-left light, cream/teal materials and deep navy shadows. Do not include a desk, chair, people or a room.
Canvas square 1024x1024, centered whole object, generous equal magenta padding all sides, solid flat #FF00FF background with NO shadow on it. ONE object, no sprite-sheet grids or labels.
The camera shows TOP and FRONT and a little RIGHT SIDE, matching the desk. Draw for a tiny 48-80px game sprite: deliberate large square pixel clusters, single logical-pixel deep navy outline, flat 2-3 tone shading per material. Logical pixels about 8 source pixels wide, no details thinner than that. No blurry or painted pixels, anti-aliasing, gradients, photorealism, text, logos or watermark.
Palette: #171C35 outline, #303750 shadow, #526078 slate, #3E7775 teal, #83A89A sage, #A88B70 brown, #D3B78D khaki, #F2D7A1 cream, #FFF0CF highlight, #874C3B rust, #C45C4B muted red, #EF9347 muted orange, #BFA8CF lavender. Warm, funny, affectionate everyday office storytelling, no frightening features.
Subject: A BROKEN OFFICE PRINTER / COPIER. Compact squat machine, warm cream plastic body with a dark teal lower cabinet, chunky scanner lid slightly raised, one large blank paper sheet jammed diagonally in the front slot and two blank sheets draping from the tray, tiny muted red error light. A small blank lavender sticky note crooked on one corner. Paper stays attached to the machine, no loose pieces on the background. Top and front clearly visible. Big readable shapes. No face, no words, no labels.

Subject: An OVERWORKED FILING CABINET. Tall compact steel cabinet, muted office teal with slate/navy sides, two large drawer fronts with simple cream handles and blank rectangular label holders. Lower drawer shut, upper drawer open a little showing three chunky khaki file folders. One leaning stack of cream paperwork resting securely on top, one tiny lavender sticky note on the side. All papers and folders below a compact maximum silhouette. No readable lettering, no face, no labels, no floor.

Subject: A SAD OFFICE PLANT. Small terracotta pot with a saucer and a single drooping plant: one bent main stem, four large broad sage/teal leaves slumping in different directions, one warm brown leaf still attached. Tiny blank cream care tag on a short stick. The plant feels neglected but endearing, not dead. Clear chunky silhouette, avoid fine fern fronds. The WHOLE pot and saucer visible from matching top-down three-quarter view. No face, words or shadow on the background.
